arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَـا الْغَيْثَ، وَانْشُرْ عَلَيْنَا رَحْمَتَـكَ بِغَيْثِكَ الْمُغْدِقِ مِنَ الْسَّحَابِ الْمُنْسَـاقِ لِنَبَاتِ أَرْضِكَ الْمُونِقِ فِي جَمِيـعِ الآفَاقِ،
transliteration: allāhumma asqinā al-ghaytha wa anshur ʿalayna raḥmataka bi-ghaythika al-mughdiqu min al-sahabi al-munsāqi li-nabāti arḍika al-mūniqi fī jamīʿi al-āfāq
english_text: O God, water us with rain, unfold upon us Thy mercy through Thy copious rain from the driven clouds, so that Thy goodly earth may grow on all horizons!

arabic_text: وَامْنُنْ عَلَى عِبَادِكَ بِإينَاعِ الثَّمَرَةِ، وأَحْيِ بِلاَدَكَ بِبُلُوغِ الزَّهَرَةِ.
transliteration: wa-amnun ʿalaa ʿibaadika bi-iynaai ath-thamaraati wa ahyi biladaka bibulughiz-zahara
english_text: Show kindness to Thy servants through the ripening of the fruit, revive Thy land through the blossoming of the flowers,

arabic_text: وَأَشْهِدْ مَلائِكَتَكَ الْكِرَامَ السَّفَرَةَ بِسَقْي مِنْكَ نَافِع دَائِم غُزْرُهُ َواسِعٌ دِرَرُهُ وَابِل سَرِيع عَاجِل تُحْيِي بِهِ مَا قَدْ مَات، وَتَرُدُّ بهِ مَا قَدْ فَاتَ،
transliteration: wa ash-hid malā'ikataka al-kerāma al-safarata bi-saqin minka naafiʿ daaʾim ghuzruhu waāsiʿun diraruhu waābilun sareeʿun ʿajil tuḥyī bihī mā qad māt, wa taruddu bihī mā qad fāta
english_text: and let Thy angels - the noble scribes - be witness to a beneficial watering from Thee, lasting in its abundance, plenty in its flow, heavy, quick, soon, through which Thou revivest what has died, returnest what has vanished,

arabic_text: وَتُخْرِجُ بِهِ مَا هُوَ آت، وَتُوَسِّعُ بِهِ فِي الأَقْوَاتِ، سَحَاباً مُتَرَاكِماً هَنِيئاً مَرِيئاً طَبَقاً مُجَلْجَلاً غَيْرَ مُلِثٍّ وَدْقُهُ،
transliteration: wa tukhrijubihī mā huwa āt wa tuwasṣiʿu bihi fil-aqwāt saḥābān mutarākiman hanī'an mari'ian ṭabaqan mujaljalān ghayra mulithhin wa dquh
english_text: bringest forth what is coming, and providest plentiful foods, through heaped up, wholesome, productive clouds, in reverberating layers, the rain's downpour not without cease,
the lightning's flashes not without fruit!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا غَيْثاً مَغيثَاً مَرِيعاً مُمْرِعاً عَرِيْضَاً، وَاسِعاً غَزِيراً تَرُدُّ بِهِ النَّهِيضَ وَتَجْبُرُ بِهِ الْمَهِيضَ.
transliteration: allāhumma isqinā ghaythan maghīthan marīʿan mumriʿan ʿarīḍan waāsiʿan ghazīran taruddu bihī al-nahīḍa wa tajburu bihī al-mahīḍa
english_text: O God, give us water through rain, helping, productive, fertilizing, widespread, plentiful, abundant, bringing back the risen, restoring the broken!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا سَقْياً تُسِيلُ مِنْهُ الظِّرابَ، وَتَمْلاءُ مِنْهُ الْجِبَابَ، وَتُفَجِّرُ بِهِ الأنْهَارَ، وَتُنْبِتُ بِهِ الأشْجَارَ
transliteration: allāhumma asqinā saqiyan tusīlu minhu al-dhirāb wa tamla'u minhu al-jibab wa tufajjiru bihi al-anhaar wa tunbitu bihi al-ashjar
english_text: O God, give us water with a watering through which Thou wilt make the stone hills pour, fill the cisterns, flood the rivers, make the trees grow,

arabic_text: وَتُرْخِصُ بِهِ الأسْعَارَ فِي جَمِيع الأمْصَارِ، وَتَنْعَشُ بِهِ البَهَائِمَ وَالْخَلْقَ، وَتُكْمِلُ لَنَا بِهِ طَيِّبَاتِ الرِّزْقِ، وَتُنْبِتُ لَنَا بِهِ الزَّرْعَ،
transliteration: wa turkhisu bihi al-asʿara fi jamiʿi al-amsari wa tanʿashu bihi al-bahāʾima wal-khalq wa tukmilu lana bihi tayyibati ar-riżqi wa tunbitu lana bihi alzara'a
english_text: bring down prices in all the lands, invigorate the beasts and the creatures, perfect for us the agreeable things of provision, make grow for us the fields,

arabic_text: وَتُدِرُّ بِهِ الضَّرْعَ، وَتَزِيدُنَا بِهِ قُوَّةً إلَى قُوَّتِنَا.
transliteration: wa tudirru bihi ad-darʿa wa tazīdunā bihī quwwatan ilā quwwātinā
english_text: let flow for us the teats, and add for us strength to our strength!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ لا تَجْعَلْ ظِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا سَمُوماً وَلاَ تَجْعَلْ بَرْدَهُ عَلَيْنَا حُسُوماً، وَلاَ تَجْعَلْ صَوْبَهُ عَلَيْنَا رُجُوماً، وَلا تَجْعَلْ مَاءَهُ عَلَيْنَا أُجَاجـاً.
transliteration: allāhumma lā tajʿal ẓillahu ʿalaynā samūmāً wa lā tajʿal bardahu ʿalaynā ḥusūmā walā tajʿal ṣawbahu ʿalaynā rujūmāً walā tajʿal māʾahu ʿalaynā ujājāً
english_text: O God, make not the cloud's shadow over us a burning wind, allow not its coldness to be cutting, let not its pouring down upon us be a stoning, and make not its waters for us bitter!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد، وَارْزُقْنَا مِنْ بَرَكَاتِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأرْضِ،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa āli muḥammad wa arzuqnaa min barakaatil-samaawaati wal-ardh
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and provide us with the blessings of the heavens and the earth!
